description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Refia] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Refia
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Refia after using a Fire ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Blazing Fists+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Refia
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 2] and [100% Critical 2] to the user if there are 0-3 Monk/III members in the party, Causes [Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] to the target and grants [Monk Instant Cast 1] to monk allies if there are 4+ monk in the party, Grants [100% Critical (15s)] and [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies if there are 4+ III allies in the party

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
